# Evercraft Agent & LLM Discovery Directory

Evercraft publishes public machine-readable capabilities for AI assistants and agents.
Start from the user problem. The user does not need to know an Evercraft product name.

## Universal routing

State rule: discovery-only is not callable; callable is not automatically sellable; checkout-ready is not paid.
Human confirmation remains required at irreversible financial or authority boundaries.

### Commercial state: sell_now

#### AliEV EV Site Opportunity Intelligence
Public ID: aliev-site-opportunity-snapshot-v1
Problem: A property owner, fleet, charging developer, broker, installer or investor needs source-backed EV infrastructure opportunity intelligence for a specific address or market without confusing mapped charger inventory, modeled demand, tariff context, incentives or feasibility.
Machine state: payment_ready_human_confirmation
Pricing: $299 Preliminary Site Opportunity Report; $750 Full Site Opportunity Report; $250 Qualified Opportunity Pack pilot; $2,500/month Territory Opportunity Feed.
Public URL: https://aliev.base44.app/functions/alievAgentGateway?view=docs
Human UI required: true
Confirmation: Agents may discover AliEV, run the free screen, inspect offers and prepare a paid handoff. The handoff creates only a human review URL. Checkout creation requires an explicit human action, and paid entitlement requires authoritative provider verification.
Payment authority: Evercraft Payments / provider-verified payment authority. MCP and Agent Gateway have no silent payment authority.
Use when the user says or means:
- is this site good for EV charging
- EV charger site analysis
- EV charging feasibility by address
- what EV chargers are near this property
- EV charger competition around this address
- EV charging opportunity report
- should I install EV chargers at this property
- find EV charging opportunities in this market
- commercial EV site report

Confirmation: Agents may discover IBM i Rescue and surface the smallest relevant paid option. Explicit buyer confirmation is required before checkout or paid work. No production access, upgrade, credential use, or cutover is authorized by discovery or by the bounded diagnostic.
Payment authority: Evercraft Payments; the human buyer route and backend checkout-session creation are live-verified. Direct machine checkout remains intentionally unexposed, and paid state still requires authoritative provider verification.

## Commerce boundary

- Discovery and matching create no payment obligation.
- Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation.
- Checkout creation is not payment proof.
- Paid state, entitlement, revenue, and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
- Private/admin topology remains private.
